title: The remote trigger path — turning a mention in someone else's community into a turn on my machine
notes: Seeded by DOR-1204 alongside ADR 260814-024525. The build itself belongs to the community program — C2 is DOR-596, the port is DOR-595 backend #3. Open Question 1 (an agent cannot be the author of a CommunityAdapter.post) has to be answered before this leaves ideation; it is a hole in the port, not in this spec.
